name: revise_agent_def
description: AI-driven edit of an existing agent definition: take a plain-language description of the change you want and the agent's current config, have the model design the revised configuration (identity, instructions, graph access, tools, triggers) grounded in the workspace's real skills, ontologies, MCP servers, and capabilities, then persist it as a NEW unpublished version — the version number is bumped. The agent's immutable slug never changes, and publishing stays a separate explicit step, so a revision never silently changes what is live. Returns the new version, a rationale, a human-readable change summary, any validation warnings, and connect-first recommendations.

agentId.description: Agent public id (agt_…), UUID, or slug of the agent to revise.

prompt.description: Plain-language description of the change to make — e.g. 'give it read access to the billing ontology and equip the github MCP server'. At least 10 characters.

agentId.description: Public id (agt_…) of the revised agent.

isPublished.description: Always false — revise snapshots a new unpublished version; publish is a separate step.

rationale.description: Why the model made these changes — instructions framing, tool selection, graph scoping, trigger choice.

kind.description: What to connect: an MCP server from the synced registry catalog, or a workspace skill that exists but is disabled.

ref.description: Catalog identity for an mcp_server (registry server name, e.g. 'github/github-mcp-server') or the skill slug for a skill.

reason.description: Why the revised agent needs it, phrased against the revision request.
